messages:
nina: Quick note - hit a parity bug in the quickstart sample: TS SDK surfaces a raw '401' string on expired keys, while Python raises an Auth.RefreshNeeded object with retryable=true.
oliver: Oh no, that's going to teach folks to pattern-match on strings.
sam: Repro is trivial: create a short-lived key, run the quickstart loop until it expires. TS catch gets Error('401 Unauthorized') and there's no stable field to detect refreshable auth.
nina: Proposal: agree on a canonical, flat client-side error shape: type (string), status (int), subcode (string, optional), retryable (bool), user_message (string), raw_body (string). Keep the type stable e.g. 'Auth.RefreshNeeded'.
oliver: subcodes should be clear: 'expired_token' vs 'invalid_key'. We should prefer server-provided subcodes (auth-service may add a header or body field) and synthesize if absent.
sam: Actionables: 1) DEVEX ticket with schema + example adapters for TS/Python/Go, 2) patch quickstart sample to use the adapter and show a friendly log message not a raw 401, 3) add CI tests that exercise the expired-key flow with a mock auth.
tesla-bot: Created DEVEX-5055: "Canonical auth error shape + quickstart sample update" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/5055).
nina: I'll draft the docs snippet for the quickstart "what to do on Auth.RefreshNeeded" (short recipe + example retry loop).
oliver: I'll take the TS adapter & feature-flagged rollout. Will add telemetry hook to count uncaught-string errors so we can gauge compatibility risk.
sam: great, i'll update the sample-app PR into draft and wire the CI test. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
